description: Rocket launches from Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral, Florida, in the next two weeks: rocket, mission, pad, day and Eastern time, Go / Hold / Scrubbed status, weather odds when posted, the live stream link, and where to watch on the Space Coast (Playalinda Beach, Jetty Park, Cocoa Beach Pier, the Kennedy visitor complex). Gives one sentence to say out loud. Use it when someone plans an Orlando or Space Coast trip or asks if there's a launch.
